title: Decisions
intro: The T04 Design Decision Log and the product gate decisions of this transformation.
logIntro: Each design decision has a generated code (D-01, D-02…), options A, B, C…, a recommendation, an owner and a status. New decisions are Open.
createNote: The code is assigned when you save. The decision starts as Open; only its owner records the choice.
emptyBody: Record the open design questions with their options so the owner can decide.
decideDescription: A business decision by the decision owner: choose an option and state the outcome. It is recorded with your name and the time.

field.title: Decision
field.ownerHint: The person who records the choice.
field.statusHint: Open, deferred or cancelled. Deciding is a separate step by the owner.

gateLogIntro: Business approvals recorded on the product gates (read-only here).
